title: Scroll: find and delete a line far down a file
instruction: The text editor has ~/bench/long.txt open. Somewhere far down there is a line that says TODO: delete this line. Delete that whole line (leave no empty line behind) and save the file.
setup: for i in $(seq 1 300); do if [ "$i" = 217 ]; then echo "TODO: delete this line"; else echo "line $i"; fi; done > "$B/long.txt"
enforced: the file is written by the editor process (fanotify writer audit), not by a shell
